records.jp: ここに来るとつい買っちゃうんだよね、<CR>ハンバーガー
records.en_original: I always end up getting a burger whenever I come here.
records.en_auxiliary: I always end up getting a burger whenever I come here.
records.en: I always end up getting a burger whenever<CR>I come here.

records.jp: 自販機ってだけで特別感あるよね
records.en_original: It feels kinda special when it's from a vending machine, doesn't it?
records.en_auxiliary: It feels kinda special when it's from a vending machine, doesn't it?
records.en: It feels kinda special when it's from a vending machine, doesn't it?

records.jp: そうそう。お店で買うのとそんなに違わないのにね
records.en_original: Definitely. Even though it tastes exactly the same as the one you get in restaurants.
records.en_auxiliary: Definitely. Even though it tastes exactly the same as the one you get in restaurants.
records.en: Definitely. Even though it tastes exactly the same as the one you get in restaurants.

records.jp: やっぱり、機械が温めてくれるのに<CR>「萌え」を感じるのかな
records.en_original: It's pretty "lit" having a machine make your meal for you.
records.en_auxiliary: It's pretty "lit" having a machine make your meal for you.
records.en: Maybe there's something moe<CR>about a machine heating it up for you.

records.jp: （「萌え」を使い慣れてない感すごいな。<CR>そこがいいんだけど）
records.en_original: (It's so obvious that's her first time ever saying that.)
records.en_auxiliary: (It's so obvious that's her first time ever saying that.)
records.en: (It's painfully obvious she isn't used to saying 'moe.'<CR>That's what makes it good, though.)

records.jp: 献立に出てこないもんね
records.en_original: Too bad they don't make them fresh by hand.
records.en_auxiliary: Too bad they don't make them fresh by hand.
records.en: It never appears on the menu, after all.

records.jp: そこまでハンバーガーが好きなわけじゃないけど、<CR>たまに食べたくなるんだよね
records.en_original: It's not like it's my favorite food or anything, but sometimes you just have to have one, you know?
records.en_auxiliary: It's not like it's my favorite food or anything, but sometimes you just have to have one, you know?
records.en: It's not like it's my favorite food or anything, but sometimes<CR>you just have to have one, you know?

records.jp: 多分お願いしたら作ってくれると思うけど、<CR>人数分作るの大変な料理だし。きっと
records.en_original: I'm sure they'd make one for me if I just asked, but things would get crazy if everyone starting asking for whatever they wanted.
records.en_auxiliary: I'm sure they'd make one for me if I just asked, but things would get crazy if everyone starting asking for whatever they wanted.
records.en: They would probably make them if we asked,<CR>but making enough for everyone must be difficult.

records.jp: ある程度用意してもらって、焼いたり挟んだりは<CR>自分でする、とかならできるのかなぁ
records.en_original: I wonder if they could make a little station where you could grill it yourself, but they'd provide the ingredients.
records.en_auxiliary: I wonder if they could make a little station where you could grill it yourself, but they'd provide the ingredients.
records.en: Maybe they could prepare part of it,<CR>and we could grill and assemble the rest ourselves.

records.jp: できるんじゃない？<CR>手巻き寿司形式ってことでしょ？
records.en_original: Kinda reminds me of Korean barbeque a little bit.
records.en_auxiliary: Kinda reminds me of Korean barbeque a little bit.
records.en: Why not?<CR>You mean in the style of hand-rolled sushi, right?

records.jp: 何かに似てるって思ってたけど、それだ
records.en_original: I knew it reminded me of something.
records.en_auxiliary: I knew it reminded me of something.
records.en: I knew it reminded me of something.

records.jp: ごちそうさまでした
records.en_original: That was delicious.
records.en_auxiliary: That was delicious.
records.en: Thanks for the meal.

records.jp: ご飯系の自販機もう一個あるけど
records.en_original: There's another machine with rice dishes if you want.
records.en_auxiliary: There's another machine with rice dishes if you want.
records.en: There's another machine with rice dishes if you want.

records.jp: んー
records.en_original: Hmmm...
records.en_auxiliary: Hmmm...
records.en: Hmmm...

records.jp: いけ……
いや、やめとく。<CR>飲みものくらいにしておこうかな
records.en_original: I think I'll hold off. I'll just get a drink.
records.en_auxiliary: I think I'll hold off. I'll just get a drink.
records.en: I think I'll hold off.<CR>I'll just get a drink.

records.jp: 悪魔のささやきに勝つなんて。<CR>意志つよ……
records.en_original: What resistance! You've got some strong will...
records.en_auxiliary: What resistance! You've got some strong will...
records.en: What resistance! You've got some<CR>strong will...

records.jp: ずっと体型維持を意識してたから、<CR>その癖が抜けないだけ
records.en_original: I always had to watch my weight for ballet, I guess old habits die hard.
records.en_auxiliary: I always had to watch my weight for ballet, I guess old habits die hard.
records.en: I always had to watch my weight for ballet,<CR>I guess old habits die hard.

records.jp: それはむしろ抜かない方がいいと思う
records.en_original: It might actually be better if you keep that one.
records.en_auxiliary: It might actually be better if you keep that one.
records.en: It might actually be better if you keep that one.

records.jp: ご一緒にドリンクはいかがですか？
records.en_original: How about a beverage, m'lady?
records.en_auxiliary: How about a beverage, m'lady?
records.en: Would you like a drink with that?

records.jp: え？　<CR>ええっと、お願いします？
records.en_original: Huh? Um... Verily?
records.en_auxiliary: Huh? Um... Verily?
records.en: Huh?<CR>Um... Yes, please?

records.jp: （勢いでノってくれてありがとう、日菜子さん）
records.en_original: (Thank goodness she played along...)
records.en_auxiliary: (Thank goodness she played along...)
records.en: (Thanks for going along with that, Hinako-san.)

records.jp: それじゃあ、なに飲む？
records.en_original: Well then, what'cha want?
records.en_auxiliary: Well then, what'cha want?
records.en: Well then, what'cha want?

records.jp: よし、決めた
records.en_original: Oh, I know.
records.en_auxiliary: Oh, I know.
records.en: Oh, I know.

records.jp: 暑いから「つめた～い」の方にしよう
records.en_original: It's so hot out, get me something coolicious.
records.en_auxiliary: It's so hot out, get me something coolicious.
records.en: It's hot, so I'll go with the one labeled 'coooold.'

records.jp: どうしたの？
records.en_original: What?
records.en_auxiliary: What?
records.en: What?

records.jp: 日菜子さん、「つめた～い」って読むんだね
records.en_original: Did you just say coolicious?
records.en_auxiliary: Did you just say coolicious?
records.en: Hinako-san, you actually read it as 'coooold,' huh?

records.jp: え？　「つめた～い」は「つめた～い」じゃないの？
records.en_original: Huh? Yeah, that's what the machine says on it, right?
records.en_auxiliary: Huh? Yeah, that's what the machine says on it, right?
records.en: Huh? Does it not say 'coooold'?

records.jp: そう書いてあっても、「つめたい」って読まない？
records.en_original: Yeah, but why wouldn't you just say cold?
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah, but why wouldn't you just say cold?
records.en: Even if it's written that way, wouldn't you just read it as 'cold'?

records.jp: だってそう書いてあるから！
records.en_original: I'm just reading what they put!
records.en_auxiliary: I'm just reading what they put!
records.en: I'm just reading what they put!

records.jp: うん、間違ってないよ。<CR>かわいいなって思っただけ
records.en_original: I guess you're right. I just thought it was cute.
records.en_auxiliary: I guess you're right. I just thought it was cute.
records.en: No, you're not wrong.<CR>I just thought it was cute.

records.jp: うう……言われるまで気づかなかった
records.en_original: Ugh... I didn't even think about it until you said something.
records.en_auxiliary: Ugh... I didn't even think about it until you said something.
records.en: Ugh... I didn't even think about it until you said something.

records.jp: ごめん、変なこと言った。<CR>なんでもないよ
records.en_original: Oh, sorry. Uh, never mind.
records.en_auxiliary: Oh, sorry. Uh, never mind.
records.en: Oh, sorry. Uh,<CR>never mind.

records.jp: もう少し涼しかったらなぁ、<CR>「あったか～い」の方でもよかったんだけど
records.en_original: If it were a bit colder outside, I'd have gone with one of the pipin' hot drinks.
records.en_auxiliary: If it were a bit colder outside, I'd have gone with one of the pipin' hot drinks.
records.en: If it were a little cooler,<CR>I could have chosen one labeled 'waaaarm.'

records.jp: （いいなぁ、このまま気づかせないようにしよう）
records.en_original: (So cute. I just won't say anything.)
records.en_auxiliary: (So cute. I just won't say anything.)
records.en: (So cute. I just won't say anything.)

records.jp: フラグメント「<CLGR>%s<CLNR>」を<CR>手に入れました
records.en_original: Obtained <CLGR>%s<CLNR> Fragment.
records.en_auxiliary: Obtained <CLGR>%s<CLNR> Fragment.
records.en: Obtained the Fragment<CR><CLGR>%s<CLNR>.
